4c525bbc-0cda-4fba-a413-ed21e071224a/Eve.en: "The wind as steed, clouds as saddle, traveling through the February days of the mortal world,<NL>Do not ask where the return journey is, sing and walk and rejoice to the fullest..."<NL><NL>Accompanied by a crisp song,<NL>"People of Wanqu" has somehow arrived before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>staggering and bowing with clasped hands towards <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, greeting and celebrating the new year,<NL>then takes out a robe from his pocket and hands it to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
4c525bbc-0cda-4fba-a413-ed21e071224a/Eve.cn: “风为马，云作鞍，踏遍人间二月天，<NL>莫计归程何处是，且歌且行且尽欢……”<NL><NL>伴随一阵清脆的歌谣声，<NL>“宛渠之民”不知何时已来到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />跟前，<NL>摇摇晃晃地朝着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />抱拳躬身，施礼贺岁，<NL>随后又从口袋中取出一身衣袍，递到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />手中……

2a0b9b0c-4f75-47e3-88fb-4db855d5c8e6/Eve.en: "On this joyous festival, the spring scenery is boundless,<NL>My companions and I specially tailored this set of Clothing for you,<NL>May everything go smoothly for you from now on, with no obstacles ahead, may you reach all destinations and fulfill all wishes!"<NL><NL>After saying this, "People of Wanqu" raises his hands, waves his sleeves,<NL>as if cracking a whip and urging a horse, and vanishes from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s sight in a blink...
2a0b9b0c-4f75-47e3-88fb-4db855d5c8e6/Eve.cn: “值此佳节，春光无限，<NL>我和伙伴们特意为你裁制了这套衣装，<NL>望你今后万事顺遂，前路无阻，所行皆至，所愿皆成！”<NL><NL>“宛渠之民”说罢，抬起双手挥了挥衣袖，<NL>似是策马扬鞭之态，转眼便消失在了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的视野里……
